# edh-c-59 (Commander lane edh-c, EDHREC ranks 20,001-20,500, second pass): a kicked-spell cost cut, a cost cut for an ability when cards were drawn, an equip ability cost cut when it targets a colorless creature, a spell cost cut for creatures that share a type, protection from each of its own colors, a death during combat, a sacrifice unless an Ogre, a redirect of the target of an opponent's spell, a largest-hand power, a random discard of a chosen number.
